blocks.title: Chromatography
blocks.text: Chromatography bunyadi taur par mixture ke ajza alag karne ka tareeqa hai. Is mein solute (mixture) ki stationary phase aur mobile phase ke darmiyan taqseem shamil hai. Stationary phase solid ho sakta hai, ya inert solid ki satah par patli tah ke taur par sambhala liquid; us par bahne wala mobile phase gas ya liquid ho sakta hai.

Solid stationary phase wali chromatography adsorption chromatography hai: madda mobile phase chhor kar solid ki satah par adsorb hota hai, jaise thin layer chromatography (TLC) aur column chromatography mein. Liquid stationary phase wali chromatography partition chromatography hai: alag kiye jane wale madde stationary aur mobile dono phases mein taqseem hote hain, jaise paper chromatography aur gas-liquid chromatography mein.

blocks.prompt: Adsorption ko partition chromatography se alag karein, aur batayein ke mutanaza dastawez par syahi chromatography se kyun jaanchi jayegi (exercise Q.2k; MCQ IV).
blocks.explanation: Adsorption chromatography mein stationary phase solid hai aur ajza is lihaz se alag hote hain ke woh us ki satah se kitni mazbooti se chipakte hain; partition chromatography mein stationary phase liquid hai aur woh dono liquids ke darmiyan apni taqseem se alag hote hain. Syahiyan rangon ke mixtures hain, aur har syahi apna spots aur Rf qeematon ka pattern deti hai, to nanhe namoonon ki chromatography dikhati hai ke dastawez ke do hisse ek hi syahi se likhe gaye ya nahi.

items: Chromatography: solute stationary phase (solid, ya solid par liquid ki tah) aur mobile phase (gas ya liquid) ke darmiyan taqseem. Adsorption (solid stationary: TLC, column) aur partition (liquid stationary: paper, gas-liquid).
